purpose: Finish the remaining identified pre-League/city/lake encounter resources before tracing unknown_533-557.
rules: Preserve city maps with no random land encounters; only their water/fishing ecology is authored.
Lake Verity keeps early-game land levels and does not randomize Jirachi or Mesprit.
Lake Acuity follows the approved post-Candice cold ecology around Lv50-54.
Lake Valor normal ecology remains available; the separate Galactic disaster basin remains story-controlled with no random encounters.
Great Marsh lookout remains informational only and is certified rather than rewritten.
